ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $\angle A=30^\circ$, and the perpendicular bisector of $AB$ intersects $AB$ at $D$ and $AC$ at $E$. If $AC=9$ cm, what is the length of $AE$ in centimeters?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect $BE$,\\
$\because$ $\angle C=90^\circ$ and $\angle A=30^\circ$, the perpendicular bisector of $AB$ intersects $AB$ at $D$,\\
$\therefore \angle ABC=60^\circ$, $BE=AE$, $\angle A=\angle EBA=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle CBE=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore BE=2CE=AE$,\\
$\therefore AC=CE+AE=9$,\\
$\therefore 3CE=9$, hence $CE=3$,\\
$\therefore AE=\boxed{6}$.
